item.title: Boom or dust? How tariffs are helping this Maine sawmill but creating more uncertainty for others
item.description: Duties on Canadian imports are driving up domestic sales at some Maine lumber companies. Is it enough to overcome high operating costs and a slumping housing market?

item.title: Ilia Malinin lifts US to gold in Olympic figure skating team competition
item.description: Malinin wins a head-to-head showdown with Japan's Shun Sato to give the Americans their second straight gold.
